learningObjectives: Identify TypeScript types and interfaces used in frontend applications.
Add type safety to component props and application data.
Use TypeScript to detect common JavaScript development errors.

activities.title: TypeScript Type Explorer
activities.instruction: Match values with their appropriate TypeScript types.

content.concept: TypeScript adds static type information to JavaScript values, variables, functions, and objects.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Interface Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a TypeScript interface.

content.concept: Interfaces describe the expected structure of objects and can improve type safety across an application.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Type Error Detector
activities.instruction: Select the type mismatch in each example.

content.concept: Type checking identifies incompatible values and function usage before runtime execution.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Typed Component Builder
activities.instruction: Build a React component with typed props.

content.concept: TypeScript can define component props and data structures to make React components safer and easier to maintain.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
